description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang' responsible for synchronizing 'lang' and 'xml:lang' attributes in HTML elements during attribute transformation within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang
classes.description: A class that transforms 'lang' and 'xml:lang' attributes to keep them synchronized during HTML attribute purification.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Copies the 'lang' attribute to 'xml:lang' if 'lang' is set and 'xml:lang' is not, or vice versa, to ensure both attributes are synchronized.
